params.body:
The owner is the one handing over, yet appeared as a chip under "Wie neemt het over" and under "Samen met" / "Wie" in "Wie draagt het vandaag".

- `CarrierPerson::isOwner()` matches the configured owner (`worksheets.network.owner`), either the name alone or followed by a surname, case-insensitive. "Geert" matches "Geert Lippens", not "Geertje Smet".
- `NodeContext::colleagues` drops that person, so both chip lists skip them; `togglePerson` only accepts someone from that list.
- The owner stays in the Medewerkers group, on the Medewerkers page and in the CSV.

Tests: 338 pass, pint clean. New test `test_the_owner_is_in_the_group_but_never_offered_to_carry_or_take_over`.
